transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what brings me in is that my head just feels really foggy lately. I'm a personal care aide, and I've been making these little mistakes in my client notes, or I'll just... forget what I was about to do right in the middle of a task. It's really not like me, so I figured I should come in and see what's going on.
Have you been sleeping well lately?

Not exactly. My sleep has been kind of all over the place lately. I'll either just lie there in bed thinking about family stuff, or I'll wake up way before my alarm goes off and I just... I can't really settle back down to get any more rest.
Have you been feeling depressed or down lately?

Yeah, I have been. Lately, I'll wake up with this heavy, kind of empty feeling in my chest. I mean, I can still get through my shift and talk to people just fine, but... inside, I just feel really sad and flat.
Have you been losing interest in or getting less pleasure from things you usually enjoy?

No, I don't think so. I still like doing my normal stuff. Like, I still enjoy watching sports or, you know, just relaxing on my days off. It's really just that sad feeling I mentioned... but I wouldn't say I've lost interest in the things I actually like to do.
When you lie awake thinking about family matters, do you feel that the worry is difficult to control?

No, I wouldn't say it's difficult to control. It's not like I'm obsessing over it or panicking or anything. I just... since I'm awake anyway, my mind naturally wanders to what's going on with my family. I can stop thinking about it or think about something else if I want to, it just doesn't really help me fall back asleep.
When you lose track during a task, is the main problem forgetting information you recently learned, or having trouble keeping your attention on what you are doing?

It's more like... my head just feels really foggy lately. That's actually a big part of what brings me in today. I'll be at work, and I'm making these little mistakes in my client notes, or I'll just completely forget what I was about to do next. It's just not like me at all.
How long have you been feeling this persistent sadness or emptiness?
I'd say it's been about a month now. That low, guilty, foggy feeling has just been hanging over me for the last four weeks or so.
During the day, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?

Yeah, I have. Even on days when I don't do much of anything, my body just feels really worn out. It seems like simple things are taking a lot more out of me than they should. Like, just helping a client shower at work, or carrying groceries into the house... it just really drains me lately.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?

Well, I'm not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. But... there have been mornings lately where I just think it wouldn't be the worst thing if I didn't wake up. And honestly, having thoughts like that really scares me.
Have you made a plan to hurt yourself or end your life?

No, no plan at all. Like I just mentioned, I'm really not going to actually do anything to end my life. It's just those mornings where I think about not waking up. But I haven't sat down and figured out a way to do it or anything like that. I definitely don't have a plan.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to do your job and manage your usual daily responsibilities?

Well, it's definitely having an impact. At work, I've actually had to ask my coworkers to double-check my client documentation for me, just to make sure I'm not missing anything. And at home... my wife has had to take over paying some of the bills and handling the scheduling. I'm just not as reliable with those kinds of details right now.
On most days, does the sadness or emptiness last for most of the day?

Yeah, it pretty much does. Lately, I wake up with this... this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, and it just kind of stays with me. I mean, I can get through my shift and talk to people just fine, but inside, I'm just sad and flat for most of the day.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite recently?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty normal. I haven't noticed any changes or anything... I'm still eating about the same as I usually do.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Yeah, I have. Lately, I just keep replaying things in my head... mostly about my tío before he passed away. I keep thinking about what I should have done differently, you know? Like, I should have called him more, or made the trip to visit him sooner. I just end up feeling like I really failed him as family. It's been weighing on me a lot.
Which started first: the persistent low mood or the foggy concentration and forgetfulness?

Actually, I haven't really noticed any foggy concentration or forgetfulness, to be honest. My memory seems fine, and I'm able to keep track of everything I need to do for work. It's really just... just the sadness that's been there. So, the low mood is the only thing that's been going on out of those two.
Do you have trouble sleeping even on nights when you are not feeling sad or depressed?
No, I don't think so. When I'm not feeling down, my sleep is... it's pretty normal, actually. I don't really have any trouble falling asleep or anything like that on a regular night.
When you think it would not be the worst thing if you did not wake up, do you ever actually want to end your life?

No, I don't actually want to end my life. I'm not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. It's just... there have been mornings where I think it wouldn't be the worst thing if I just didn't wake up. And honestly, having thoughts like that scares me. But no, I don't want to actually do anything to end it.
